text:
sam: Deploybot just rejected the publish for payments:v2.14.0 in us-west-2 — it says manifest platform label is amd64 but our release expects arm64. Anyone watching the release window?

deploy-bot: AUTOMATION: publish rejected -> PUBLISH_LABEL_MISMATCH. Registry reported label mismatch for tag `v2.14.0` (manifest[0].platform == "amd64" != expected "arm64"). Logs: https://ci.internal/reports/5492 :warning:

morgan: on it, checking the build matrix and image manifest now

alejandra: quick eyeball: the new base image in the Dockerfile defaulted to amd64 last night when the cross-builder env var fell back. We built the amd64 artifact and it got pushed as v2.14.0.

sam: options: 1) pin canary to previous digest (v2.13.9) so change window stays green and re-run proper arm64 build; 2) retag this image as payments:amd64-v2.14.0 and publish an arm64 build as v2.14.0 (messy for consumers). I prefer pin+rebuild.

deploy-bot: Humans must confirm rollback/pin. To pin run:```
releasectl pin --service payments --digest sha256:8f3b...e2a --env canary --reason "platform label mismatch"
```

morgan: +1 for pin. I can run the pin and update release notes. If we pin, we should also create a follow-up ticket to rebuild with CROSS_TARGET=arm64.

alejandra: rebuild time estimate: ~15m build, ~10m integration smoke tests. Attestation/cosign will be generated once the new image is pushed; note that some registries have short attestation TTLs that could delay deploybot acceptance by a minute or two.

sam: approved. @morgan please pin now and add the quick release note: "hotfix: pin to previous digest due to platform label mismatch; arm64 rebuild in progress". Also add change-window tag so ops knows it's intentional. :white_check_mark:

morgan: running pin now. CLI output:```
$ releasectl pin --service payments --digest sha256:8f3b2a1c...e2a --env canary --reason "platform label mismatch"
INFO: locking rollout for payments canary
INFO: pinned canary to digest sha256:8f3b2a1c...e2a
INFO: notified deploybot to refresh routes
STATUS: canary pinned -> stable until manual unpin
```

morgan: updated release notes: "v2.14.0 canary pinned to v2.13.9 digest due to platform label mismatch on initial publish; arm64 rebuild underway; expect republish and canary migrate once attestation completes." Added ticket RED-4021 to backlog.

alejandra: starting rebuild now with CROSS_TARGET=arm64. I will post build link when finished.

sam: thanks. tagging this thread for follow-up. If rebuild finishes cleanly we'll unpin and let deploybot promote. If not, we'll keep pin and open a rollback decision later. :thumbsup:
